worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.summary: Blow a wide, short fan of powdery snow in the aim direction: every enemy in the fan not blocked by cover takes a light Ice hit, is pushed back half a step, and may be frozen. It winds up fast and recharges quickly, so it can be blown again and again to stack freeze rolls, and can be blown into open air.
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.use.0: Catch several enemies packed in front of you
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.use.1: Blow it again and again to keep rolling for freezes
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.use.2: Push a body that has closed in back half a step
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.description: Takes the nearest enemies in the fan first, skipping those behind blocks, up to %2$s, each taking about %1$s special damage.
Blow distance %1$s blocks, fan half angle %2$s degrees, and a struck target is pushed %3$s blocks away from the user.
Each target caught in the fan has a %1$s chance to be frozen; while frozen it can neither use moves nor move, lasting about 8 s, and Fire-type damage thaws it early.
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.flurry.on: Flurry mode now: a wider, longer fan that reaches more targets with a higher freeze chance, but each hit is lighter and the cooldown is a little longer.
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.flurry.off: Powder mode now: a narrower fan with a heavier hit per target and a shorter cooldown, good for point damage at close range.
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per target rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.powdersnow.growth.1: From level %1$s power per target %2$s and blow distance %3$s.
On: fan half angle x1.25, distance x1.15, +1 max target and +3%% freeze chance, but x0.85 per target and +2 cooldown. Off: powder mode, x1.15 per target, distance x0.92 and a shorter cooldown.
The companion only considers Powder Snow while a target is within this many blocks; the move is very short-ranged, so a large value still only helps up close.
When on, the companion prefers targets with others packed around them (one fan catches several); off picks a single target for close-range point damage.
